page.layout: Running head at top, centred: "INDEX". Two parallel columns of index entries, left column then right column. No margin notes. Below the right column: signature at left and catchword at right.
page.notes: The page is a printed index (INDEX), two columns, with no marginal notes. Page number not printed; only the gathering signature "S 5" and the catchword "pro-" at the foot. Doubtful readings: "ta, ad" in "pœnarum atrocitas specta-" line is uncertain (marked [?]). "238" in "promotionis insignia" may be 235 (marked [?]). Signature "S 5" is partly unclear. Printing errors left as printed: "pœnitetia" (for pœnitentia) in "pœnitetia in quibus sita 21"; "punes" for "impunes" in the line after "pios opprimentes". "Pluviæ" and "vexanda", "viata", "evangelij", "permoveant", "avaritia" are corrected only for u/v spelling. Handwriting in the left margin (a hand-drawn mark) and the ink mark beside "insignia" are not transcribed.
